_doc: Prompt template for AI-generated props (GDD 10: realistic, invented designs). {placeholders} come from the asset's 'vars' in config/assets.json.
prompt: Photorealistic 3D game prop: {object}. Materials: {materials}. Real-world proportions, plain unbranded surfaces, PBR materials, isolated object, even studio lighting
negative: logo, text, letters, numbers, brand, emblem, sponsor, watermark, person, cartoon, stylised, base, pedestal, ground plane
